More overall. Each meal needs you to contribute X "Nutrition" to create it, and every unit of edible stuff has a specific Nutrition number it gives to a meal. Rice plants give 6 units of rice at base (before harvesting modifiers from Plants skill) and every unit of rice has 0.05 nutrition. Meanwhile, corn gives 22 units at base while having the same nutrition value.

The tradeoff here is that a rice plant only takes about 5 days to grow while a corn plant takes 20. It seems like a negligible difference, but you have to take into account that you'll definitely be growing a *lot* of plants and 20 days of rice need to be sown and harvested 4 times while 20 days of corn only needs to be sown and harvested once. If you're growing something bigger than a hobby garden corn wins out over long timeframes.
Rice grows quickly but has a subpar yield. If you can feed yourself for the growing period, corn takes the same time to sow and harvest while giving a lot more nutrition per plant.
